name: Leadership Styles
excerpt: Leadership Styles include laissez-faire, transactional, servant, transformational, charismatic, and interactional.
notes: Leadership Styles in project management include laissez-faire, transactional, servant, transformational, charismatic, and interactional. Each style has different approaches to leading and inspiring teams.
